title: Prevalence calibration as shortcut mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Shortcut learning denotes the widespread situation in which a classifier exploits spurious correlations rather than diagnostic features. Existing mitigation strategies mostly aim to learn shortcut-invariant representations; their empirical success is limited and they cannot be applied to classifiers using frozen foundation model encoders. We propose to reframe shortcut learning as fundamentally a calibration problem: unconstrained learning implicitly calibrates each shortcut group to its training set disease prevalence, rendering the resulting classifier necessarily over-confident in one group and under-confident in the other. Building on this insight, we prevalence-equalize calibration between shortcut groups through two encoder-agnostic methods, an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc prevalence-equalized recalibration step. Across chest-drain-pneumothorax benchmarks on CheXpert and SIIM-ACR, spanning fine-tuned CNNs and frozen fou

translated_title: 患病率校准作为捷径学习缓解方法
translated_abstract: 捷径学习是指分类器利用虚假相关性而非诊断性特征的普遍现象。现有的缓解策略大多旨在学习捷径不变表示；但它们的实证效果有限，且无法应用于使用冻结基础模型编码器的分类器。我们提出将捷径学习重新构建为一个本质上属于校准问题的框架：无约束的学习会隐式地将每个捷径组的校准对齐到其训练集中的疾病患病率，使得所得的分类器必然在一组中过度自信而在另一组中自信不足。基于这一见解，我们通过两种与编码器无关的方法实现捷径组之间的患病率均衡校准：一种是处理过程中的正则化器，另一种是事后患病率均衡重校准步骤。在CheXpert和SIIM-ACR数据集的胸腔引流-气胸基准测试中，涵盖微调的CNN和冻结的基础模型编码器
tldr: 该论文创新性地将捷径学习重新定义为校准问题，并提出两种与编码器无关的患病率均衡校准方法（处理中正则化和事后重校准）来有效缓解捷径依赖，且可应用于冻结基础模型编码器。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes shortcut learning as a calibration problem and proposes two encoder-agnostic prevalence-equalized calibration methods—an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc recalibration step—to mitigate shortcut reliance, including on frozen foundation model encoders.
